title: Extracted relationship candidate
description: One line of data/extracted/<source_id>.jsonl. Candidates are not graph edges until reviewed and merged.

input.description: Input id from data/seed/inputs.csv, or a proposed new kebab-case id if none fits (set input_is_new).

excerpt.description: Verbatim text from the cached document that states the relationship. Checked by the validator.

locator.description: Section heading, page or item number where the excerpt appears.

strength.description: disclosed only for filings (10-K, 20-F, annual report); reported for everything else. Extraction never emits inferred.

anonymised.description: True when the document names the counterparty only as e.g. 'Customer A'; the entity then records the extractor's identification and why.

mention.description: The name exactly as written in the document.

node_id.description: Matching id from data/seed/nodes.csv, or null if no node matches yet.

proposed_name.description: Canonical name to use if node_id is null.
